overview: City Councilors Liz Mullane and Justin Tseng hosted a Ward 1 neighborhood meeting to gather feedback from residents. Participants raised concerns regarding local noise issues, traffic safety, development plans, and city communication.

items.title: Meeting Opening and Resident Introductions
items.summary: City Councilors Liz Mullane and Justin Tseng opened the neighborhood meeting and invited residents to introduce themselves and outline their primary concerns.

items.title: Discussion on Noise Ordinance Upgrades
items.summary: Councilors discussed ongoing plans to rewrite the city's outdated 1974 noise ordinance to establish objective decibel limits and clarify enforcement roles between city departments.

items.title: Traffic Calming and Pedestrian Safety Concerns
items.summary: Residents highlighted specific areas with speeding and unsafe crosswalks, prompting discussions on local traffic-calming solutions and coordination with the state's Department of Conservation and Recreation.

items.title: Linkage Fees, Development, and the Wellington Study
items.summary: Councilors detailed upcoming adjustments to developer linkage fees to pay for infrastructure and shared updates on the long-term Wellington Transformation Study.

items.title: Upcoming Meetings and Municipal Communication
items.summary: Councilors announced upcoming public committee and ward meetings and addressed suggestions to improve the city's directory and C-Click-Fix customer service systems.
